opener: it is 11:11 somewhere. probably. anyway. i finished it. crimson tears pt V. the saga the world was not ready for, continued regardless

my tears are crimson / like a sunset that got fired / the moon left my heart on read / i am a glitter bomb / detonating softly / at a funeral for my old screen name / but it's ok. the glitter forgives me

choices.say: darkangel this is genuinely your best one. 'detonating softly' goes hard. or... soft. either way it goes.

them: the moon hears through walls, {you}. she has heard every diary entry since the dawn of diaries. this is basic lunar science

truth: it's your best, because 'detonating softly' is a real, actual, great line. i mean it.

choices.say: the skull commenters mean well. but yeah — open on the moon. trust the moon.

them: end ON the funeral?? but the glitter forgiving me is the emotional resolution, {you}. the GLITTER. FORGIVES ME. that's the hug at the end of the movie

choices.say: unresolved glitter is the strongest glitter. leave them wanting pt VI.
forgiveness is earned, not granted. the glitter can forgive in pt VII. maybe.
what happened at the quinceañera

choices.say: end on the funeral. for pt II. for the glitter. for jessica's quinceañera.
end on the funeral, and save the forgiveness for a future installment. ash today, closure never.

them: okay. okay okay okay. new draft: 'the moon left my heart on read / i am a glitter bomb / detonating softly / at a funeral for my old screen name.' four lines. lean. mean. crimson-adjacent

wait. who DID fire the sunset. is there a sky manager. an hr department of the horizon. what have you done. my mind is a cathedral of new questions

sorry. the poem is good, i just have an extremely literal brain.

them: the moon has an away message, obviously. it says 'waning. brb.' it has said this for one thousand years. THAT is the tragedy, {you}. she is never brb

i want ten percent of all glitter royalties.
